# EZ-Tree

Upstream: https://github.com/dgreenheck/ez-tree
Commit: dcf309bd86bd521083d9c70f01f2de45fdc7c457
License: MIT, see LICENSE (also included in embedded.js).

The lib directory is an unmodified copy of src/lib at this commit, retained as a reference from the earlier realistic tree version. The current tree-shaped umbrella installation does not import this recursive generator: its single trunk, roof ribs and leaves are implemented in ../../tree-model.js to keep the hanging-photo area clear. No network requests are needed at runtime.

Shape reference only (not copied into the application or city albums): Tmquinn2, Angel Oak Tree.JPG, Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 3.0.
https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Angel_Oak_Tree.JPG
